name: Kbd
description: One keyboard key in a cap, a native `kbd`: at `sm`, the default, a hint beside a menu item, a tooltip's text or a field; at `md`, a key that is the content, as in a list of shortcuts. One key per cap: write a shortcut as a KbdGroup of Kbd, or from key names with KbdShortcut.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` (the default) is a hint beside something else: a menu item, a tooltip, the search trigger, an input. `md` is a key that is the content, in a list of shortcuts.

name: KbdShortcut
description: One shortcut from key names: a cap per key, with the platform's drawings (icons on a Mac, words elsewhere), and the shortcut in words for a screen reader. Alternatives ("⌘↑ / ⌘↓") are two KbdShortcut with a separator between them, written by the caller.

props.name: keys
props.description: The keys, by name, case-insensitive, in any order: `["mod", "shift", "enter"]`. `KeyboardEvent.key` values work too (`ArrowUp`, `Meta`). Modifiers are drawn first, in the platform's order; the other keys follow in the order written.

props.name: label
props.description: What a screen reader says instead of the key names, which are English: pass the product's own words for another language ("Shift Command 回车").

props.name: platform
props.description: The keyboard to draw for. Without it, the platform the page runs on, detected once on the client (`other` on the server and while hydrating).

props.name: size
props.description: The size of every cap, as `Kbd`'s.
